cited_by.title: Melatonin for sleep: what it does, dose and rules by country

record.population: 31 commercial melatonin supplements (different brands and forms)
record.design: Laboratory analysis of melatonin and serotonin content by chromatography
record.finding: Melatonin content ranged from 83 per cent below to 478 per cent above the label. Lot-to-lot variation reached 465 per cent. More than 71 per cent of products missed the label by more than 10 per cent, and serotonin was found in eight (about a quarter).
record.note: Products sold in one market at one time. It is a reason to doubt labels and ranks no product.
